Condition implementation:

```python
def _cond_provenance(t: Transition, w: WorldView) -> Verdict:
    # P0 shape
    if len(t.sig) != 64 or len(t.artifact_root) != 32:
        return Verdict(False, 0x02, "E_BAD_SIG")
    pk = w.get(NS_ACTOR_KEY + t.actor_id)
    if pk is None or len(pk) != 32:
        return Verdict(False, 0x01, "E_NO_KEY")
    msg = h32(DOMAIN_PROV, CHAIN_ID, t.epoch.to_bytes(8,"big"),
              t.nonce.to_bytes(8,"big"), t.actor_id,
              t.artifact_root, bytes([t.to_state]))
    if not ed25519_verify(pk, t.sig, msg):
        return Verdict(False, 0x02, "E_BAD_SIG")
    reg = w.get(NS_PROV_REG + t.artifact_root)
    if reg is None or len(reg) != 9:
        return Verdict(False, 0x03, "E_NOT_ACTIVE")
    status, expiry = reg[0], int.from_bytes(reg[1:9], "big")
    if status != 0x01:
        return Verdict(False, 0x03, "E_NOT_ACTIVE")
    if expiry <= w.epoch:
        return Verdict(False, 0x04, "E_EXPIRED")
    if t.epoch not in (w.epoch - 1, w.epoch):
        return Verdict(False, 0x05, "E_STALE_EPOCH")
    last = w.get(NS_NONCE + t.actor_id)
    last_n = int.from_bytes(last, "big") if last else -1
    if t.nonce <= last_n:
        return Verdict(False, 0x06, "E_NONCE_REPLAY")
    if h32(t.payload) != t.artifact_root:
        return Verdict(False, 0x07, "E_BIND_MISMATCH")
    prefix = NS_ARTIFACT + t.actor_id + b"/"
    if any(not k.startswith(prefix) for k, _ in t.writes):
        return Verdict(False, 0x08, "E_PATH_ESCAPE")
    return Verdict(True, 0x00, "OK")
```

    pk = w.get(NS_ACTOR_KEY + t.actor_id)

    if len(pk) != 32 or not ed25519_verify(pk, t.sig, prov_msg(t)):
        return Verdict(False, E_BAD_SIG, "signature")

    reg = w.get(NS_PROV_REG + t.artifact_root)
    if reg is None or len(reg) != 29:
        return Verdict(False, E_NOT_ACTIVE, "no registry entry")
    status = reg[0]; expiry = int.from_bytes(reg[1:9], "big"); owner = reg[9:29]
    if status != 0x01:
        return Verdict(False, E_NOT_ACTIVE, f"status={status:#x}")
    if owner != t.actor_id:
        return Verdict(False, E_NOT_OWNER, "registry owner mismatch")
    if expiry <= w.epoch:
        return Verdict(False, E_EXPIRED, f"expiry={expiry} epoch={w.epoch}")

    if t.epoch not in (w.epoch - 1, w.epoch):
        return Verdict(False, E_STALE_EPOCH, f"att epoch={t.epoch}")

    last = w.get(NS_NONCE + t.actor_id)
    last_n = int.from_bytes(last, "big") if last is not None else -1
    if t.nonce <= last_n:
        return Verdict(False, E_NONCE_REPLAY, f"nonce={t.nonce} last={last_n}")

    if h32(t.payload) != t.artifact_root:
        return Verdict(False, E_BIND_MISMATCH, "payload != artifact_root")

    own_prefix = NS_ARTIFACT + t.actor_id
    for k, _ in t.writes:
        if not k.startswith(own_prefix):
            return Verdict(False, E_PATH_ESCAPE, f"key {k.hex()} escapes owner ns")

    return Verdict(True, E_OK, "all preconditions hold")
